items.title: General public comment at Select Board
items.summary: Residents can speak to the Select Board about any Town issue. Sign up in advance starting the Friday before, or in person at the meeting.

items.title: Public hearing: 26 Pleasant Street Zoning (Article 15)
items.summary: Continued hearing on a Special Town Meeting warrant article to change zoning for 26 Pleasant Street. Each speaker gets three minutes.

items.title: Public hearing: Legal Fees Budget Amendment (Article 4)
items.summary: Hearing on a warrant article to amend the legal fees budget; petitioners say they won't move it at Town Meeting.
items.skip_reason: Petitioners do not intend to move the article

items.title: Public hearing: Resolution to Settle Claim (Article 5)
items.summary: Hearing on a warrant article resolution about settling a claim.

items.title: Public hearing: Residential Parking Minimums (Article 10)
items.summary: Hearing on a warrant article about parking minimums for housing; petitioners say they won't move it at Town Meeting.
items.skip_reason: Petitioners do not intend to move the article

items.title: Public hearing: Inclusionary Zoning (Article 14)
items.summary: Speak at the Select Board hearing on a November Special Town Meeting article about inclusionary zoning, which requires affordable units in new housing. Each speaker gets three minutes.

items.title: Appeal of Chestnut Hill Avenue Transportation Board decision
items.summary: Public hearing on an appeal of the Transportation Board's decision about rehabilitating and changing uses on Chestnut Hill Avenue. Residents can comment for three minutes after the appeal is presented.

items.title: Liquor, entertainment and food licenses
items.summary: Individual business license approvals and transfers.

items.title: Eversource conduit petitions on Stearns Road and Kent Street
items.summary: Approval of underground conduit locations to individual properties.
